description: Interactive Blazor report viewer with toolbar navigation, zoom modes, parameter panel integration, refresh, PDF/CSV/XLSX export callbacks, loading/empty/error states, and canvas snapshot rendering. Drill-through regions projected by the rendering engine are overlaid as clickable hotspots: clicking one resolves the target report reference and the parameter values mapped from the clicked context and raises OnDrillThrough, leaving the actual navigation to the host.

examples.title: Handling drill-through navigation
examples.code:
<TmReportViewer Source="@_source" TenantId="acme" UserId="@UserName" CultureName="en-US"
                OnDrillThrough="HandleDrillThrough" />

@code {
    private void HandleDrillThrough(ReportDrillThroughResolution resolution)
    {
        if (!resolution.HasTarget)
        {
            return;
        }

        // resolution.TargetReportPath / TargetReportId plus resolution.Parameters
        // carry the mapped values; the host decides how to navigate.
        Navigation.NavigateTo(ReportDeepLink.Build(resolution)!);
    }
}

parameters.name: AutoLoad
parameters.description: Whether the viewer renders immediately after metadata is loaded.

parameters.name: ShowParameterPanel
parameters.description: Whether the parameter panel starts visible.

parameters.name: ShowParameterPanelToggle
parameters.description: Whether users can toggle the parameter panel from the toolbar.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant identifier passed to report sources.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: User identifier passed to report sources.

parameters.name: SnapshotChanged
parameters.description: Fired after a snapshot is rendered.

parameters.name: OnDrillThrough
parameters.description: Fired when a drill-through region is clicked, carrying the resolved target report reference and the parameter values mapped from the clicked context. The host decides the actual navigation.

parameters.name: PdfExported
parameters.description: Fired after a PDF export is produced.

parameters.name: CsvExported
parameters.description: Fired after a CSV export is produced.

parameters.name: XlsxExported
parameters.description: Fired after an XLSX export is produced.
